freshness_method: All selected IDs are planned as fresh deliberate targets; guarded promotion must independently check them against all canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 sequences 1-24 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: argument, reason, evidence, or proof supporting a claim
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta lists argument, reason, evidence, and proof among the meanings of دلیل.

targets.intended_sense: attributed or ascribed to a cause or source
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives related, connected, attributed, ascribed, and referred to for منسوب.

targets.intended_sense: estimate; an approximate calculation or judgment
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines تخمینہ as an اندازہ, rough calculation, or estimate.
Rekhta gives روزانہ کا معمول and عام/ہر روز کا among the senses of روزمرہ.

targets.intended_sense: gradually, step by step, by degrees
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta defines بتدریج as آہستہ آہستہ, درجہ بدرجہ, and gradually/by degrees.

targets.intended_sense: encouragement, inducement, or motivation toward an action
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives رغبت دلانا, شوق دلانا and inducement/stimulation for ترغیب.
Rekhta defines پیاس as پانی پینے کی خواہش / thirst.

targets.intended_sense: fat, grease, or oiliness; in the passage, dietary fat as a broad category
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta lists grease, oil, animal or vegetable fat, and oiliness for چکنائی.
Rekhta defines اعتدال as میانہ روی and a middle course without excess or deficiency; Cambridge maps moderation to اعتدال/میانہ روی.

targets.intended_sense: attention, consideration, inspection, or close review/observation
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta lists attention, regard, consideration, close examination, review, inspection, and looking for ملاحظہ.

targets.intended_sense: measure, measuring instrument, scale, standard, or criterion
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta gives measure, standard, yardstick, scale, آلہ پیمائش, and معیار for پیمانہ.
Rekhta gives خیال, تصور, فہم, شعور, سمجھ بوجھ and English perception/understanding for ادراک.

targets.intended_sense: practice or exercise undertaken to improve a skill
targets.external_evidence: Rekhta/Platts lists an exercise, practice, usage, and مشق کرنا for practising/exercising.
Cambridge uses درحقیقت for 'in fact' and in contrast/correction uses of 'actually'; the National Council for Promotion of Urdu Language glossary gives درحقیقت = in fact, in truth.
Rekhta gives الگ, مختلف and English separate/distinct for جدا.

generation_guardrails: All scenarios are explicitly instructional or fictional and must not be presented as clinical studies or individualized medical advice.
P1-P5 introduce exactly three new lexical targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all fifteen.
All six passages retain ten questions and ten linked answers, with a 220-320 whitespace-token B1 passage band.
Learner-facing title, passage text, questions, and answers use Urdu script only.
Health-adjacent passages teach evidence evaluation and bounded claims; they do not diagnose, prescribe treatment, or provide individualized intake targets.
Guarded promotion must fail closed on any target-ID freshness collision against prior canonical Urdu.
Generation/integrity status remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
freshness_scope: Exact target IDs checked against all canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 sequences 1-24 immediately before Unit 5 append.
